subject: Social Media
title: JOMO: The Joy of Missing Out
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on JOMO: The Joy of Missing Out.

hook.text: She deleted Instagram for a week. First day: panic. Third day: relief. Seventh day: she read a book.

buildup.text: JOMO—joy of missing out—is the antidote. It means choosing absence and finding peace in it.

discovery.text: Anil Dash coined JOMO in 2012. He argued that opting out of the stream is a radical act of self-care.

twist.text: JOMO is hard to maintain. Social obligations, work requirements, and habit pull you back into the feed.

climax.text: Complete disconnection isn't realistic for most. The real skill is selective presence—choosing when to engage.

punchline.text: Missing out can be the best thing you do.
